items.title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive/SharePoint web viewer
items.summary: We're enabling PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. With this update, users who have the appropriate usage rights can annotate these protected PDFs in place in their browser while preserving the file's sensitivity label, encryption, and usage rights when changes are saved.GA date: January CY2027

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pinch to zoom in on shared screens
items.summary: Get a closer look at shared content in Teams calls and meetings with pinch-to-zoom using your touchpad. Quickly zoom in to make small text and detailed visuals easier to see, then zoom back out for the full view. Existing zoom controls remain available.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Full-screen mode on task grid
items.summary:
Task grid full-screen mode enables project managers and team members to expand the task grid to use the available screen space. By minimizing surrounding page elements, users gain a larger workspace for viewing and managing task hierarchies, schedules, assignments, dependencies, and other task details.
Users can enter full-screen mode when they need a focused planning experience and return to the standard project view when they need access to other project information.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: SharePoint: Copilot Search in SharePoint and OneDrive
items.summary: Copilot Search brings AI-powered, natural-language search to SharePoint and OneDrive, combining relevant results, AI-generated summaries with source references, intuitive filters, and a seamless handoff to Copilot.GA date: January CY2027Preview date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
items.summary: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.GA date: November CY2027

items.title: Power Apps: Prompt Columns - multiple lines of text output
items.summary: Prompt columns can now store multilple lines of text as prompt output, enabling longer and detailed AI-generated insights to be stored in your tables.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Prompt column values in bulk for existing records (backfill)
items.summary: Prompt columns can now generate AI values for records that already exist in your table, not just new or updated ones. Makers can choose to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk, optionally filtered to just the rows they need, so historical data gets the same AI-generated insights as incoming data, without touching each record one at a time.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
items.summary: For non-channel Microsoft Teams meetings, collaborative meeting notes, including Loop-powered meeting notes and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive for Business instead of the OneDrive of the person who starts the notes. This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
items.summary: Gain proactive visibility into meeting quality across your organization with AI-powered insights in the Teams admin center that identify emerging patterns, highlight impacted users and locations, and surface likely causes with recommended actions. This helps IT administrators detect and address issues earlier, improve meeting quality, and stay ahead of potential disruptions.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
items.summary: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Phishing Detection in Teams Messaging
items.summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing AI-powered phishing detection that uses conversation context to identify phishing and social engineering in higher-risk messaging scenarios, primarily external first-contact chats. Additional protection may apply in certain regions or scenarios. The capability is used only for security protection, and users may see warnings when suspicious activity is detected.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot response personalization - Memory citations
items.summary: When Copilot Chat uses memory to personalize a response, users can now see what informed the answer. Select Sources beneath the response, then open the Personalization tab to view the custom instructions, saved memories, memories learned from conversations, and past chats that shaped the response. From there, users can return to a cited chat to pick up where they left off or review and delete saved memories. Memory citations appear only when memory is turned on.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality evaluation - One-Time Evaluation Frequency
items.summary:
Quality evaluation plans now support a Once frequency type for both case evaluations and conversation evaluations. When creating an evaluation plan, users can select Once from the Frequency type dropdown to run the evaluation a single time instead of on a recurring schedule or trigger-based cadence.
This option is useful for one-time evaluation runs where ongoing recurrence is not needed. Once selected, the plan is configured to execute only one time based on the specified plan start date.GA dat

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent in Copilot V2 Improvements
items.summary:
Planner Agent brings Planner’s intelligent work management directly into Copilot Chat, enabling users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared basic plans without switching context. Integrated across Microsoft 365, it provides insights into priorities, deadlines, and at-risk work, along with interactive task cards to help users stay organized and keep work moving.
Building on the initial launch, planned improvements include:

Improved context handling and support for larger plans.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
